paper_title: PromptMind Team at EHRSQL-2024 Improving Reliability of SQL Generation   using Ensemble LLMs
caption: Individual vs Ensemble Models
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Cost and Reliability Score for three different modeling approaches. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with numeric tick labels placed at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 20. The plot contains three distinct solid lines, each featuring circular markers plotted at x-axis values of 0, 5, and 10. The line representing the "3-Model Ensemble" is colored blue and shows a steady decline across the x-axis, starting at a Reliability Score of approximately 82 at a Cost of 0, passing through roughly 79 at a Cost of 5, and ending at approximately 75 at a Cost of 10. The line for the "2-Model Ensemble" is colored red and exhibits a steady downward trend, beginning at a Reliability Score of about 85 at a Cost of 0, decreasing to approximately 79 at a Cost of 5, and concluding at roughly 73 at a Cost of 10. The line representing "GPT-4" is colored yellow and demonstrates a continuous downward trajectory across the x-axis, initiating at a Reliability Score of approximately 89 at a Cost of 0, dropping to roughly 65 at a Cost of 5, and finishing at approximately 41 at a Cost of 10.
